title: Luke Skywalker
description: LUKE SKYWALKER leaves Tatooine to search for an endangered princess - and his own destiny. As he helps the Rebel Alliance battle the evil Darth Vader and the Emperor, he learns the ways of the Force, an energy field created by all living things that binds the galaxy together. He also has to confront a terrible truth: Vader is really his father. With cunning and new-found inner strength, Luke helps lead the Alliance to victory.
